pins.name: Spec
pins.says: The journal starts empty, and every step is a decide, ratify, supersede or link write, a process finishing or stopping mid-write, a merge, a branch taking main in, or a branch dropping a conflicting ratify.

pins.name: TypeOK
pins.says: Every checkout and main hold a journal of lines per decision ID, the store holds a sequence of recorded lines, and at most one write is in progress.

pins.name: UniqueIds
pins.says: No two decisions ever take the same ID, in any checkout, on any branch, merged or not.

pins.name: MainKeepsLines
pins.says: Every line main has ever had is still on main, in the same place.

pins.name: StoreKeepsLines
pins.says: The store's journal only grows: every line it ever recorded is still there, in the same place, including lines from branches that never merged.

pins.name: RatifiedByPerson
pins.says: Every ratify line on main names a person.

pins.name: NoAgentOneWayDoor
pins.says: No one-way door on main was decided by an agent; an agent can only propose one.

pins.name: JournalsWellFormed
pins.says: In every checkout and on main, a journal's first line records its decision, no later line does, and no ratify comes after a ratify or a supersede.

pins.name: RatifiedOnMain
pins.says: A decision can be ratified and reach main.

pins.name: AgentProposalRatifiedOnMain
pins.says: An agent can propose a one-way door and a person can ratify it on main.

pins.name: SupersededOnMain
pins.says: A decision can be superseded on main.

pins.name: BothBranchesOnOneDecision
pins.says: Two branches can each add a line to the same decision and both reach main.

pins.name: GapInIds
pins.says: A process that stops mid-decide can leave a gap in the IDs while a later decision reaches main.

pins.name: DecideFileFirst
pins.says: A decide writes the journal file first and stops before the store records the ID.

pins.name: MergeOverwrite
pins.says: A branch merges without checking that main's lines are still in it, in place.

pins.name: AgentRatify
pins.says: An agent writes a ratify line.

pins.name: SyncUnchecked
pins.says: A branch takes main in without checking whether that puts a ratify after a ratify or supersede.
